connector.name: ZeroDrop
connector.registryDescription: Disposable email inboxes for AI agents - OTPs and magic links auto-extracted. No signup needed.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package zerodrop-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.zerodrop, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZERODROP_API_KEY
env.description: ZeroDrop Workspace API key. Omit for free sandbox mode.
